What are langchains?
Langchains is a framework helps develpoers to build applications using large language models(LLMs).

- Langchains or lang-graphs pass one's output as another's input automatically.
- There are two types of models namely language models and embedding models
    - Now the language models are text to text generators whereas the embedding models are used for semantic search.

- Types of prompting
    - Dynamic & reuseable
    - Rule based
    - Few shot prompting.

Chains
provides one's output as an input to other
